interface.shortDescription: An in-house motion-design studio for AI agents
interface.longDescription:
Motion Master is an in-house motion-design studio for AI agents.
It ships 61 skills: the LottieFiles motion-design doctrine, the official GSAP and Remotion skills, the motionmaxxing craft law with its measured gates, sixty complete film styles, 124 authored shot cards, 244 reusable motion effects and a 3988-item open-source prompt library, each keeping its own licence and attribution.
The Motion Master router adds the motion doctrine, the palette and type tokens, the anti-slop rules and the brand kits.

The MCP server exposes 47 tools. It plans the shot list and writes the animation, then renders the file on your own machine and hands you a video you own.
There is a deterministic prompt enhancer that diagnoses a weak brief and fills only what is missing, 448 installable HyperFrames motion blocks with the lint and layout gate that decides what ships, a render queue that works one job at a time, and a 1470-sound effects shelf. An HTTP API at /api/v1 serves the same tools to scripts and CI.

Every render passes a hard gate: contrast, text floor, occlusion, overlap and the motion budget. A render that fails the gate is not published.

Motion Master is not on sale. It is used in-house. The terms it would ship under are recorded in licence.json at the repo root and are not published.
